aria: Animated recap of the Mavericks' 125 to 122 home win over Indiana: Cooper Flagg's 18-foot pull-up with 26.3 seconds left, quarter-by-quarter scoring, his season-high 43 points, the top scorers, how the Mavericks won, and the next game at Minnesota.
notes: Box score from the Mavericks' 125–122 home win over the Indiana Pacers on Nov 9, 2026, from the Covers.com box score, with game details from the AP (via CBS News Texas), Field Level Media (via the Hawaii Tribune-Herald), the Dallas Sports Journal, Sports Illustrated's Mavericks and Pacers sites and Yardbarker. All 125 Mavericks points and all 122 Pacers points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals and match the running scores in the recaps (66–56 Indiana at the half, 93–90 after three). The biggest leads (Indiana 13 at 63–50, Dallas 8 at 116–108) are from Covers, Field Level Media and the Dallas Sports Journal. Flagg's 30 second-half points are from Field Level Media and his 13 first-half points from Sports Illustrated. Dallas being three games over .500 for the first time since March 2025 is from the AP. The next game is from the AP and Yardbarker; the Timberwolves' record and the Mavericks' standing are from the site's standings.

The play of the game is an original illustration of Cooper Flagg's 18-foot pull-up with 26.3 seconds left, which made it 123–119 (the Dallas Sports Journal; Sports Illustrated's Mavericks site describes it as a midrange jumper after Naji Marshall split a pair of free throws). It came one trip after another 18-foot pull-up that made it 120–116, and they were his last points: 42 and 43. Aaron Nesmith's three then cut it to 123–122, Kyrie Irving's two free throws made it 125–122 with 18 seconds left (Field Level Media), and Caleb Martin stole the last inbounds pass. It is drawn as a plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Dallas Mavericks or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Flagg’s listed 6-foot-9 and 205 pounds (Basketball-Reference), with arms scaled to his 7-foot wingspan at the 2025 draft combine (CBS Sports), in the Mavericks' home white with No. 32 (Basketball-Reference). His look hasn't been approved yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
